note: Sites 069 and 070 on Hunter Road, about 125 m apart and 3 miles in from PA 235, both described as larger sites suitable for trailers, one camping unit each. 069, east of Spring Trail, is an open grassy clearing roughly 35 m by 45 m in full sun, up a 255-ft gravel driveway graded moderate that climbs about 9 m from the road. 070, on the south side west of Gold Spring Trail, is a parallel pull-off beside the road under the trees. Fire rings and picnic tables, nothing else. On 2026-11-10 ReserveAmerica showed both as Not Available on every night checked through September 2027, with no reason posted. State forest roads are not plowed in winter, and some Bald Eagle roads need 4WD and high clearance: check the route. --Claude
summary: Both site pages re-read: open year round, prices shown ($10/$15 + $6.50), but NOT bookable on any night queried. 069: 50 ft, back-in, moderate 255-ft driveway; 070: 40 ft, parallel. Imagery rendered (leaf-on): 069 an open grass clearing ~35 x 45 m at the pin; 070 under closed canopy 18 m from the road. 3DEP: 069 9.1 m above Hunter Road over 95 m (about 10% mean). Pins match ReserveAmerica and DCNR GIS (TrailerAccess 'Yes' on both). No NHD flowline within 200 m.
flags: CANNOT CURRENTLY BE BOOKED ONLINE: every site of this entry showed 'Not Available' on every night queried on 2026-11-10 (Nov 17-30 2026, May 12-25 2027, Jul 14-27 2027; also Dec 15-28 2026, Mar 15-28 2027 and Sep 20-Oct 3 2027 for 069), and the forest's site-list grid shows the same X ('Not avail.') while neighbouring sites (021, 027, 030, 031, 034, 064-066) are open or reserved. The pages are NOT labelled 'Walkup Only' and still show prices, so booking was left as reservable. No reason found on the site pages, the ReserveAmerica forest alerts or the DCNR Bald Eagle advisories page (its only advisory is the Pine Creek Hollow Road bridge closure from May 26 2026). The same block covers 022, 029 and 041, i.e. the Paddy Mountain / Cherry Run / Old Mingle / Poe Paddy group plus Hunter Road 069-070. Owner question: keep with the dated caveat (written into the note), or hold/drop until DCNR reopens them? A call to the district would settle why.
069 driveway: 'Driveway Grade: Moderate', but 3DEP gives about 10% mean over the 255 ft from Hunter Road; gravel.
070 is 'Driveway Entry: Parallel' (a roadside pull-off, spur 40 ft): not a pull-through, so pull_through is false for the entry.
Kind of place: 069 carries 'Horse Site' and DCNR GIS says 'Larger site, suitable for horse trailers'. Single reservable campsites, kept.
No 'RV Site' among the equipment categories on any Bald Eagle site page in this entry (069 'Horse Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site', 070 'Tent Site, Trailer Site'): by the brief that is keep, flagged.
